exercises.title: U5 听力·对话 A Trip to the Wildlife Park
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Lucy: This weekend, would you like to visit the new wildlife park with me?
Tom: That sounds great! Which animals can we see there?
Lucy: They have tigers, monkeys and lots of beautiful birds.
Tom: I'd love to see the tigers most of all. When should we go?
Lucy: Let's go on Saturday morning, when the animals are most active.
Tom: Good idea. Should we bring our cameras?
Lucy: Yes, but remember we must stay quiet and not feed the animals.
Tom: Of course. I can't wait for Saturday!
exercises.translation_cn: 露西约汤姆周末去新开的野生动物园;那里有老虎、猴子和许多漂亮的鸟;汤姆最想看老虎;两人决定周六上午去,因为动物那时最活跃;露西提醒要保持安静、不要喂动物。

options: The animals are most active then.

exercises.title: U5 听力·短文 Why Bees Matter
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Bees may be small, but they are very important to nature.
As they move from flower to flower, they help plants make seeds and fruit.
Without bees, many of the foods we eat every day would disappear.
Sadly, the number of bees has been falling in many countries.
We can help them by planting flowers and using fewer chemicals in our gardens.
exercises.translation_cn: 蜜蜂虽小,却对自然非常重要;它们在花间穿梭,帮助植物结出种子和果实;没有蜜蜂,我们每天吃的许多食物都会消失;遗憾的是,许多国家的蜜蜂数量一直在下降;我们可以多种花、少用化学药剂来帮助它们。

questions.stem: What does the passage say about bees?
options: They are very important to nature.

questions.stem: How do bees help plants?
options: They help plants make seeds and fruit.

questions.stem: What would happen without bees?
options: Many of our foods would disappear.

questions.stem: What has been happening to the number of bees?
How can people help bees?
options: By planting flowers and using fewer chemicals.

exercises.title: U5 听力·对话 A New Kind of Frog
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Host: Today we are talking to Dr Lee, who found a new kind of frog. Welcome!
Dr Lee: Thank you. Yes, we discovered it deep in the rainforest last year.
Host: How is this frog different from the others?
Dr Lee: It is bright blue, and it is no bigger than your thumb.
Host: Amazing! How did you know it was really a new species?
Dr Lee: We compared its body carefully with every frog we already knew.
Host: And what will you name it?
Dr Lee: We named it after the forest where it lives, to remind people to protect that place.
exercises.translation_cn: 主持人采访发现新蛙的李博士;李博士说去年在雨林深处发现了它;这种蛙亮蓝色、只有拇指大小;为确认是新物种,他们把它的身体与已知的每种蛙仔细比较;他们以它栖息的森林为它命名,以提醒人们保护那片森林。

questions.stem: What did Dr Lee find?
Where was it discovered?
What does the frog look like?
options: It is grey and very large.
It has no colour at all.
It is bright blue and very small.

questions.stem: How did the team make sure it was a new species?
options: They counted how many there were.
They compared it with frogs they already knew.

questions.stem: Why did they name it after the forest?
options: To remind people to protect the forest.
Because the name was easy to say.

exercises.title: U5 听力·短文 The Giant Panda
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: The giant panda is one of the best-loved animals in China.
Although it is a kind of bear, it eats mostly bamboo.
A panda may spend over twelve hours a day just eating.
Years ago, pandas were in great danger because their forests were cut down.
Thanks to careful protection, their numbers are now slowly rising again.
exercises.translation_cn: 大熊猫是中国最受喜爱的动物之一;它虽是一种熊,却主要吃竹子;一只熊猫一天可能花十二个多小时进食;多年前,因森林被砍伐,熊猫曾陷入巨大危险;由于精心保护,如今它们的数量正在缓慢回升。

questions.stem: Where is the giant panda best loved?

How long may a panda spend eating each day?

exercises.title: U5 听力·对话 A Visit to the Botanical Garden
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Mia: Our biology teacher wants us to visit the botanical garden. Are you coming?
Jack: Definitely. I've heard they have plants from all over the world.
Mia: They do. There is even a special house full of plants that eat insects.
Jack: Plants that eat insects? I really want to see those!
Mia: Me too. We also need to choose one plant and write a short report.
Jack: Which plant will you choose?
Mia: I think I'll write about the giant water lily. Its leaves are huge.
Jack: Good choice. I'll write about the insect-eating plants, then.
exercises.translation_cn: 米娅约杰克去生物老师安排的植物园参观;那里有来自世界各地的植物;甚至有一间专门养食虫植物的温室;杰克特别想看食虫植物;参观后每人要选一种植物写一篇短报告;米娅打算写叶子巨大的王莲;杰克则决定写食虫植物。

options: Choose a plant and write a report.

exercises.title: U5 听力·短文 A Tip for Protecting Nature
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a simple way for anyone to help protect nature.
You do not need to travel far or spend a lot of money.
Start in your own neighbourhood by keeping it clean and green.
Plant a tree, save water, and never drop litter in wild places.
Small actions, repeated by millions of people, can truly change the world.
exercises.translation_cn: 这里有一个人人都能保护自然的简单方法;你不必远行,也不必花很多钱;从自己的社区做起,保持它干净、绿色;种一棵树、节约用水、绝不在野外乱扔垃圾;当千百万人重复这些小小的行动时,就能真正改变世界。

questions.stem: Who is this tip for?
options: Anyone who wants to help nature.

questions.stem: Does helping nature need a lot of travel and money?
options: No, you can start close to home.

questions.stem: Where should you start?

options: Plant a tree and save water.

questions.stem: What can small actions do when many people repeat them?
